import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t**2 + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2
    K = p[7] + p[8]*t
    n = p[9]
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    return base + amp*An/(np.abs(K)**n + An)
